_comment: The BALANCED-BASIS arm, moved out of the base config on 2026-09-14. Commit 0288236
(2026-08-21) turned these flags on IN THE BASE, which pointed desk.z_dir and
latent_cube.z_dir at a basis that no DESK was ever trained against: the production
checkpoint is 2026-08-20, one day older than encoder/esk_balanced/spacetime. The base
config therefore described a system that did not exist on disk for three weeks, and
nothing detected it -- desk_meta.npz did not record the basis, and validate's
recent_basis_residual compares a basis against ITSELF, so it cannot see the mismatch.
The two bases are NOT interchangeable. Measured on 4,000 bbs_points rows:
Gram relative difference        0.016   (same Ruzicka kernel, as the contract requires)
median ||z_A - z_B|| / ||z||    1.087   (completely different COORDINATES)
Procrustes ||AQ - B|| / ||B||   0.089   (reachable by one rotation Q)
subspace cosines                min 0.287, mean 0.976
So they agree as kernels and disagree as coordinate systems. Any metric built on raw
coordinates -- zspace_reconstruction's ||z_DESK - z_obs|| above all -- is measuring Q
rather than the model if the basis it grades in is not the basis DESK trained in.
Adopting this arm is therefore a full re-fit AND retrain: spacetime-esk -> desk -> cube,
in that order, with this overlay active for all three. Grading an existing checkpoint
through it is not a cheaper approximation of that, it is meaningless.
ESK_DESK_CONFIG=config/overlays/basis_balanced.json STAGES=spacetime-esk bash scripts/tacc/submit_encoder.sh
ESK_DESK_CONFIG=config/overlays/basis_balanced.json STAGES=desk        bash scripts/tacc/submit_encoder.sh
ESK_DESK_CONFIG=config/overlays/basis_balanced.json STAGES=cube        bash scripts/tacc/submit_encoder.sh
bbs_routes.spatial_regions is deliberately NOT carried here. It was raised to 2 by the
same commit, but it is an evaluation-reporting knob rather than a basis or training one,
and every validation JSON now on disk was produced at 2. Reverting it would change those
reports for a reason unrelated to the basis.
